info.title: when
info.description: Convert timestamps between formats, apply time arithmetic, and calculate durations.

options.name: --utc
options.description: Output only UTC ISO 8601 string (conversion mode)

options.name: --local
options.description: Output only local ISO 8601 string (conversion mode)

options.name: --iso
options.description: Output only ISO 8601 duration string (diff mode)

options.name: --tz
options.description: Display in this timezone (IANA or Windows ID)

options.name: --describe
options.description: Structured JSON metadata for AI agents

options.name: --color
options.description:
Coloured output: auto (default when omitted), always, or never
Input Formats:
now                  Current instant
Unix epoch           1718745600 (seconds, 1-10 digits) or 1718745600000 (millis, 11-13 digits)
ISO 8601 date        2024-06-18 (treated as midnight UTC)
ISO 8601 datetime    2024-06-18T16:00:00Z (with or without timezone offset)
Note: bare 4-digit values like 2025 are rejected as year/epoch-ambiguous (see 'man when').
Offsets:
+/-N{d,h,m,s}        Relative offset, e.g. +7d or -2h30m
ISO 8601 duration    e.g. +P1DT12H (days/hours/minutes/seconds only)
